assessments.assessment: The compiler retains exact lane proposal objects and records the selected decision object plus predecessor hash. It replaces historical independent-review status with an explicit pending state unless actual separate review bindings are provided. Added root metadata is distinguishable from the primary author and exact immutable fragments. Every original case and every selected original proposal is checked through a unique predecessor lineage. No source winner is selected by the compiler.

The overlay is keyed by actual owner paths, removes the old owner before inserting its destination, rejects repeated owners/destinations and authenticates original before bytes. It uses the unchanged native guarded writer/schema and full-baseline partonomy, plus case-exact path checks and introduced identifier collision detection. Conditional candidates are exercised together only for structural diagnosis; this cannot approve their simultaneous installation or final identity selection.

The lineage pass preserves complete predecessor history prefixes, inherited rejected-label objects and role/occurrence/causal-graph fields. W02 classification is applied to the identified evidence entries. My separate assembly audit additionally compares the full original object digest to each W02 suggestion, avoiding reliance on enum value alone.

The assembly explicitly records before/after policy wording and asserts substantive hold objects unchanged. All188 source/occurrence/raw-label digests are independently compared in the draft-v5 receipt; no current held source admission is inferred from a report disposition.

Ten historical handles are retained across HEPES, acid Wolfe, modified Wolfe and nominal95% ethanol. The matrix gives positive source facts, missing facts, bounded shared-representation options and required provenance/component obligations. Unknown pH/carrier/hydration does not prove difference or identity. All17 ethanol routes and six generic magnesium aliases remain conditional. These limitations must survive the final handoff and native review.

Media science is /root/media_research reviewed by /root/final_skeptical; materials science is /root/materials_research reviewed by /root/media_research; chemical science is /root/chemicals_research under /root/materials_research review. Root assembly/report amendments retain /root attribution. This assembly reviewer is not a primary source-payload author or compiler.
